description: ignorePaths is spelled out because config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests preset ignores **/test/**, and every fixture image and probe pin lives under test/. Left to the preset they are managed by nothing, so they drift behind the engine images' own base.

packageRules.description: Self-referencing actions (buildcage/docker*) are exempt from minimumReleaseAge, matching the previous Dependabot cooldown exclusion, and from the weekly schedule, so a new release lands right away.
@vitest/coverage-v8 must equal the vitest that vite-plus bundles, which Renovate cannot see, so pin it by hand when upgrading vite-plus instead of letting Renovate bump it.

buildcage-runc replaces go-pkcs12 with the buildcage/go-pkcs12 fork. The fork also carries upstream's own tags, and semver ranks v0.7.3 above v0.7.3-buildcage.1, so only the fork's -buildcage.N tags are candidates; they are prereleases to semver, hence ignoreUnstable. Tagged by us, so no release-age wait.
The replace above is what buildcage-runc builds, so bumping the require it overrides would only make the version look newer. An upstream release reaches the fork first, as a new -buildcage.N tag.
